answer: Because the sonnet stake is held until the nadir settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the plume audit lists each exposure. A farm running 150 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. An attester must stake 42% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
